tei:div.tei:p: (shrī)༄༅// mgon po dzam+bha la dmar po'i phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i cho ga pad+ma rā ga'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ bla ma gsang ba'i bdag po dang*// dbyer med rmugs 'dzin dbang gi rgyal// spyi bor mchod nas de nyid kyi// phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i phrin las spel// de la 'dir grwa mngon dzaṃ dmar la brten pa'i g.yang chog lag tu len pa'i tshul la gsum/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi gshom bkod/ dngos gzhi sgrub pa'i phrin las/ rjes dngos grub sdud pa'i las rim mo// dang po ni/ nyi ma byang bgrod kyi dkar phyogs 'grub pa'i sbyor ba dang bkra shis pa'i nyi ma sogs dge zhing shis pa'i dus su/ yid 'ong gtsang ma'i gnas la 'byung po 'dul byed dang dzaṃ dmar gyi bris sku sogs rten bkram pa'i mdun du stegs bu phying dkar gyis g.yogs pa la/ spro na glang po che'i pags pas dngos sam bris pa bting ba'i steng du pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar tshom bu dmar po dgod/ de'i dbus su mañdzi'i khar rin po che'i snod gtsang mar 'bru sna tshogs dang g.yang rdzas bsres pa'i phye las grub pa'i ri rab bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du dril gzugs dang rin chen zur brgyad kyi khar bum pa nor bu mig gsum gyi tog can rtsa bar tshe ril gyis bskor ba 'bri smug gis byugs pa la/ rtse phran nor bu 'bar ba la pad+ma nyi zlas brgyan pa sogs gang mdzes dang*/ ri rab kyi bang rim dang por ne'u le nor bu skyugs pa dang*/ bang rim rnams la rin po che 'bab pa/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ nor bu cha bdun sogs rgyan spros gang mdzes/ mda' dar dmar po me long gis brgyan te btsugs pa bkod/ de'i shar du rin po che'i snod rgyun 'bab kyi chus bkang ba/ lhor ri bkra bzang po'i sa dang byin rlabs can gyi sa sna/ nub tu tsan+dan dmar po'am shug pa'i sdong bu can gyi mar me/ byang du rlung g.yab dkar po ste 'byung bzhi'i bcud dgug pa'i rdzas bzhi/

mtshams bzhir bcud dgug pa'i zhal zas bzhi/ lho nub tu rin po che'i bum pa'am dkar yol lam rdza sogs kyi bum pa skyon med pa'i nang chang bzang po la bu ram sbrang dkar chos sman btab pa'i nang du/ mar gyi nor bu cha bdun la sogs pa nor bu'i rigs kha dog sna tshogs pa byas pa dang*/ nas dang gro yi dbyibs can dang*/ dud 'gro'i sna 'ju sogs kyi gzugs brnyan bcos pa blugs la/ dar dmar gyi mgul chings bya/ kha phye mar dang mar khus bcad/ dar la rdo rje rgya gram bris pas bkag pa'i steng du zan gyi nor bu mig gsum bkod pa'i phywa bum bzhag ma grub na gong gi rgyu las gtor ma zlum po dbal cung zad btod pa rtsi dmar pos byugs pa pad+ma dang*/ nor bu lta bu'i zan ril gyis phyur bur spungs pa/ nyi zla nor bu'i rgyan can zas snas bskor ba bzhag las tshogs nas 'byung ba'i gwa'u dang thod pa'i rten yod na g.yas g.yon du bshams shing*/ med na gzhung nas bshad pa'i g.yang rdzas dang*/ g.yang chang rnams tshogs par bya/ de'i mdun du zangs snod du 'bul gtor dmar po sha chang zas sna g.yang rdzas kyis gtams pa/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod sgor mchod dam sbreng tshar/ nye logs gang bder chu sbyin gyi chas/ bsang rdzas/ tshogs 'khor gyi yo byad/ bkra shis rdzas rtags sna bdun snod bcud kyi bkod pa sogs spyan gzigs dkor cha byin chags par bsham/ sngon 'gro phywa glud kyi gtor ma dkar gtor gnyis dang*/ bgegs gtor glud gzugs rdzas dang bcas pa/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo dril/ mda' dar dmar po/ me tog gzhan rol mo'i bye brag bcas 'du bya'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ bdag gi rnal 'byor dang*/ phywa g.yang gi phrin las so// dang po ni/ gnas khang dang yo byad byin gyis brlab pa kye rdor ltar la chu gnyis nyer spyod kyi tshig bsgyur ba sngon tu btang ba'am/ gang ltar yang 'byung po 'dul byed kyi bdag bskyed dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsung las 'byung ba lta bu bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar nyams su blang*/

de nas phywa glud kyi gtor ma 'dod dgu phun sum tshogs pa'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsams la/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal po chen po bzhi oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ tsa turma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ gtor ma gnyis pa byin rlabs sngar bzhin dang*/ slar yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ phywa khu ye/ shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung*// dri za gshin rje'i rgyal po ste// shar phyogs khams la dbang gis bsgyur// rje blon btsun mo 'khor du bcas// phywa glud bzang po 'di bzhes la// phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir khug cig /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir phob cig /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir skyobs shig /lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po// grul bum ma mo'i rgyal po ste// lho phyogs khams la dbang gis bsgyur// rje blon btsun mo 'khor du bcas// phywa glud bzang po 'di= /phywa dang g.yang ni= /dgos 'dod char ltar= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzang*// klu dang bdud kyi rgyal po ste// nub phyogs khams la dbang gis bsgyur// rje blon btsun mo 'khor du bcas// phywa glud bzang po 'di bzhes la// phywa dang g.yang ni= /dgos 'dod char ltar= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras// gnod sbyin sha za'i rgyal po ste// byang phyogs khams la dbang gis bsgyur// rje blon btsun mo 'khor du bcas// phywa glud bzang po 'di bzhes la// phywa dang g.yang ni= /dgos 'dod char ltar= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /steng phyogs tshangs pa brgya byin sogs// lha chen brgyad po thams cad de// steng phyogs lha yi tshogs bcas rnams// phywa glud bzang po=

/phywa dang g.yang= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni= /'og phyogs dga' bo 'jog po sogs// sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad de// 'og phyogs gnas pa'i tshogs bcas rnams// phywa glud bzang po= /phywa dang g.yang ni= /dgos 'dod char= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /bar snang nyi zla rgyu skar dang*// gza' dang gdong mo gzed sman sogs// bar snang gnas pa'i tshogs bcas rnams// phywa glud bzang po 'di= /phywa dang g.yang ni= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /phyogs mtshams bdud rmu rgyal po btsan// srin po 'byung po ma mo dang*// g.ya' sman gangs sman mtsho sman dang*// yul phyogs 'dir gnas gzhi bdag dang*// dam sri gdon bgegs thams cad rnams// phywa glud bzang po 'di bzhes la// phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir khug cig /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir phob cig /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir skyobs shig /ces pas gtor ma bsngos nas phrin las bcol lo// phywa rdzas bsang ba ni/ bgegs gtor gcig la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs te/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥsogs kyis bsngos la/ rdo rje dril bu thogs te 'di skad du/ hūm̐/ gsang chen sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// dngos grub stsol phyir 'du 'gyur ba'i// lha dang srung ma ma gtogs pa'i// dngos grub bar du gcod byed pa'i// gdon bgegs 'byung po khyed cag rnams// mchod sbyin gtor mas tshim gyis la// ma 'tshe bar ni gzhan du dengs// ci ste mi 'gro 'dug byed na// bde gshegs kun 'dus thugs gnyis med// ye shes khro bo'i 'phro 'du yis// bgegs dpung thams cad rdul phran bzhin// 'thag 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// ces brjod cing rol mo dang bcas te/ oṃ sum+bha sogs dang*/ yungs thun brdeg cing mtshams gcad do// phywa sgo bsdam pa ni/ shar gyi sgo ma lcags kyu ma// dkar mo zhi ba'i las la brtson// dung gi sgo mo bsdams nas kyang*// phywa dang g.yang du 'dir=

/dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /lha yi sgo ma zhags pa ma// ser mo rgyas pa'i las la brtson// gser gyi sgo mo bsdams nas kyang*// phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /nub kyi sgo ma lcags sgrog ma// dmar mo dbang gi las la brtson// zangs kyi sgo mo bsdams nas kyang*// phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni= /byang gi sgo ma dril bu ma// sngon mo drag po'i las la brtson// g.yu yi sgo mo bsdams nas kyang*// phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar= /tshe dang dpal ni= /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// zhes pas sgo ma bzhi la las bcol/ gnas yo byin rlabs gong du ma byas na 'dir bya zhing*/ ghāṇ+ṭe ra ṇi ta rol chen dang bcas pas byin dbab bo// de nas mdun gyi rten rnams a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las zla ba/ ma las nyi ma/ pam̐ las pad+ma'i gdan gyi steng du yi ge dzaṃ dmar po las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus dzaṃ la phog de yongs su gyur pa las dzaṃ bha la dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku shin tu dmar ba/ chags pa dang sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ klu chen po brgyad dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa/ zhal g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon sngo ba/ rtsa zhal dmar ba/ phyag g.yas dang po na rin po che/ bar pa lcags kyu/ g.yon dang po thod pa rin po ches gang ba/ gnyis pa zhags pa/ tha ma gnyis na gter gyi ne'u le re re bsnams nas/ btsir bas nor bu skyugs pa/ zhabs bzhis gnod sbyin nor bu skyugs pa gnyis mnan pa/ de'i thugs kar yi ge hrīḥdamar po las lha mo ku ru kul+le dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis mda' gzhu/ g.yas 'og ma lcags kyu/ g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa'i thugs kar hrīḥdamar po las 'od 'phros pas lha mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas lcags kyu g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa/

de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i dbus su hrīḥdamar po de las 'od 'phros pas mgon po dzam+bha la dmar po nor lha gter bdag gi tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hrīḥ mgon po thugs rje'i spyan ldan rgyal ba kun// 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar// gnod sbyin gter gyi bdag po'i rnam rol pa// 'khor bcas thugs dam dbang gis 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes spyan drangs la bzhugs su gsol/ mchod rdzas la bsang chu 'thor te/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i nye bar spyod pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang thun mong khyad par gyi mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes byin brlabs/ oṃ/ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// mar me dri chab zhal zas dang*// rol mo la sogs nyer spyod rnams// dbang mdzad dzam+bha la la 'bul// gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim dang*// ro bda' reg 'jam bde ba dang*// chos yid tshim byed 'dod yon drug /dbang mdzad dzam+bha la la 'bul// mi dbang rgyal srid rin chen bdun// nye bar 'os pa bdun dang bcas// bkra shis rtags rdzas brgyad zung rnams// dbang mdzod dzam+bha la= /phyi snod 'byung lnga las grub pa'i// lhun po ri gling sa mtshor bcas// mtho ris dpal 'byor gyis phyug pa// dbang mdzad= /rin chen rdul brtsegs dpag bsam shing*// ma rmos lo tog 'dod 'jo'i ba// gter chen bum bzang nam mkha'i mdzod// dbang mdzad=

/kha dog dri ro phun tshogs pa// zag med bde ba skyed byed pa'i// lha rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod gtor 'di// dbang mdzad= /dag cing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// bza' bca' btung ba sna tshogs pa'i// longs spyod tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'di// dbang mdzad= /g.yul las rgyal byed mtshan ma sogs// phyi nang gsang ba de kho nas// thugs dam skong ba'i sgrub rdzas kun// dbang mdzad dzam+bha la la 'bul// dngos su 'byor dang yid sprul pa// ting 'dzin sngags rgya'i mthus bsgrubs pa'i// kun bzang mchod sprin mtha' yas pas// mkha' dang phyogs mtshams kun bkang ste// dbang mdzad dzaṃ la 'khor bcas la// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags na// dgyes par dgongs te bzhes nas kyang*// bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// oṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ rū pa/ shab+da/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she/ dharma dhā tu kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ rat+na maṇ+ḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ ma hā ba liṃ ta dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta ga ṇa tsakra sarba pū dza sid+dhi āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bstod pa ni/ bde gshegs kun gyi gsung las rab sprul zhing*// thugs rje chags pas sku mdog dmar por bzhugs// dbang gi phrin las rdzogs mdzad dzam+bha la// ma lus 'gro ba'i re skong la phyag 'tshal// zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhis nor skyugs mnan// 'gro ba'i re skong yid bzhin rin chen dang*// khams gsum 'gugs par byed pa'i lcags kyu gnyis// g.yas gnyis dang po bar pas bsnams par mdzod// rin chen thod pa zhags pa g.yon gnyis na// tha gnyis ne'u le btsir zhing rin chen 'bebs// rnam mang rin chen nor gyi char phab nas// ma lus 'gro ba'i re skong la phyag 'tshal// zhal g.yas dkar bas lha rigs dbang du sdud// g.yon zhal sngo bas klu rigs dbang du sdud// dbus zhal dmar bas mi rnams dbang du sdud// srid gsum dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo// sku la rin chen du mas rnam par brgyan// klu chen brgyad dang lha yi na bzas brgyan// sgeg pa'i nyams ldan 'gro ba kun yid sdud// mgon po dzam+bha la la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag la longs spyod nor chen dngos grub stsol// zhes bstod/

bzlas pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi dzam+bha la'i thugs srog hrīḥdamar po las lha mo ku ru kul+le dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis mda' gzhu/ g.yas 'og ma lcags kyu/ g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa'i thugs kar hrīḥdamar po las 'od 'phros pas lha mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas lcags kyu g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa grangs med pa spros te/ 'jig rten khams kyi nor rdzas kyi rnam pa gang 'dod pa la lcags kyus bzung zhags pas bcings nas rang gi khyim du drangs/ khang par mi shong ba tsam spungs te byin/ dzam+bha la'i zhal dang*/ ne'u le'i zhal dang*/ gnod sbyin nor skyugs gnyis po'i zhal rnams nas gser g.yu mu tig byi ru la sogs pa zad mi shes pa brul nas bdag gi khang pa khengs par gyur/ oṃ dzam+bha dza len+d+rā ya dha na me dhi hrīḥswā hā/ zhes ci mang bzla'o// chu sbyin no// tshas mdun du bstar la/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar ram̐ dmar po las me 'bar te/ zhal nas me lce lhab kyis byung pas dzam+bha la de skom pas gdungs par bsams la/ oṃ dzam+bha la sogs sngags gong ltar brgya'am nyer gcig tsam brjod cing chu gtsang phul bas skom pa zhi nas mnyes te/ zhal nas rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa dang*/ ne'u le gnyis kyang phyag gis btsir bas nor bu skyugs/ zhabs 'og gi nor bdag gnyis la zhabs kyis cher mnan pas kyang nor bu skyugs shing*/ de lta bu'i nor bus khyim gang par bsams la mthar/ dzam+bha la'i zhal dang nor bdag ne'u le gnyis la rang gi lag pas reg pas dngos grub bdud rtsi dmar po'i rnam pa de nyid lce la myong bar bsams te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes chu la reg cing btungs pa'i lhag kyang rang gis longs spyad par bya'o// gtor 'bul ni/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rin po che las grub pa'i snod du gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

ces brjod cing byin rlabs byas te/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye nas/ dzam+bha la'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya dha na me dhi i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin dang*/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab bo// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ ma dag dngos 'dzin nyes skyon bsregs gtor bkrus// zag med 'dod yon ye shes bdud rtsir gyur// zhes lan gsum brjod/ tshogs yul spyan 'dren pa ni/ 'dod dgu'i mchog stsol rmugs 'dzin gter gyi bdag /'gro ba'i dbul phongs sel mdzad 'khor dang bcas// ye shes tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston la// dgyes shing brtse bas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥs spyan drangs/ tshogs phud ni/ 'dod yon zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i gter// rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar rab sprul te// skyabs gnas mchod 'os spyi dang khyad par du// nor bdag dzaṃ la 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// rtsa sngags la ga ṇa tsakra pū dzaḥhoḥ zhes phul bas dgyes par bsam/ skong ba ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel/ hrīḥ ma chags pad+ma'i longs spyod rdzogs pa nas// khyab bdag 'od dpag med mgon sras bcas byon// sor rtog ye shes dbang mdzod 'od klong nas// rmugs 'dzin dmar po gnod sbyin 'khor bcas byon// dwangs srog thig le zla gam 'khyil pa nas// sbas yum rig byed ḍā ki'i tshogs bcas byon// thugs rje'i dbang gyur rtsa gsum rab 'byams lha// 'dir gshegs dgyes par bzhugs la dngos grub stsol// dad pa rnam gsum sa gzhi bstar ba la// tshul khrims gzhal med khang pa bkod legs mdzes// mang thos nye bar spyod pa'i sprin phung bkod// gtong ba'i 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod sgo dbye// khrel yod rig ma'i bde gar dga' bzhi sbar// bag ldan lha sngags ting 'dzin rol mo rtse// shes rab 'phrul gyis 'khor gsum dag par spel// rgyal ba mnyes byed kun bzang mchod sprin 'dis// bde ba chen po mtsho skyes yab yum sogs// rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang*// snang ba mtha' yas 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i=

/dbang chen rdo rje rta yi zhal can sogs// yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug= /gsang ba ye shes myur mdzad dpa' mo sogs// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dam can= /rnam mang thos sras dzaṃ lha mched lnga sogs// gter bdag nor lha bye ba'i= /dgyes par dgongs la mchog thun dngos grub stsol// khyad par tshe bsod longs spyod dar rgyas mdzod// hrīḥ lha mchog thugs dam mnyes byed khyad par rdzas// bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen rnam pa bdun// gter gyi bum bzang dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing*// 'dod 'jo'i ba mo rin chen dbyig gi gter// 'chi med bdud rtsi dmar chen khrag gi mtsho// 'bras chan khur ba shing tog dkar mngar bcud// māṃ sa rang byung sbyar ba'i chang sna sogs// bza' bca' btung bas zangs gzhong phyur bur bkang*// rin chen ga'u mtshan ldan ban dha dang*// shel dkar tsit+ta yid sgyur rdzas kyis bltams// sku gzugs bla rdo srog gi tsakra sogs// phyi nang gsang rten sgrub dang mchod skong rdzas// mthun pa'i yo byad nam mkha' gang ba 'dis// mgon po gsung gi dbang phyug thugs dam bskang*// chu dbang gter gyi bdag po'i= /rmugs 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug /sbas yum ku ru kul+le'i= /myur mgyogs las kyi pho nya'i= /sprul 'khor bye ba dung phyur= /ma rig dug lnga'i rgyus bskyed sdig kun dang*// khyad par 'dod chags ser sna'i dbang gyur pas// ma byin len sogs dbul phongs las bsags pa// lha mchog thugs rje can gyi spyan sngar bshags// chos dbyings 'gyur med dga' bas mnyes pa'i gar// ye shes 'dzum bag sgrub pa po la ston// bstan dang bstan 'dzin mnga' thang dgung du spor// bdag dang chos bzhin spyod pa mtha' dag la// grub gnyis bdud rtsis 'phral yun 'tsho ba sbyor// tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgya mtsho gong du spel// snyan grags dbyar gyi rnga chen srid rtser sgrogs// 'dzad med dgos 'dod gter sgo brgya phrag phyes// khams gsum srid gsum mos bzhis dbang du sdus// gzhan phan phrin las chu rgyun mkha' mthar drongs// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi// dbul phongs sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras sel ba dang*// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar// lha mchog khyod dang mi 'bral 'grogs pa yis// 'dod pa'i 'bras bu myur du mchis par mdzod// dpon slob rnams la tshogs drangs te/

bdag nyid lhar gyur mgrin par dzam+bha la// gsal bas tshogs rdzas longs su spyad par gyur// don bsam zhing rol/ lhag ma bdud rtsir spel la/ oṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣā ya swā hā/ zhes 'byung po rnams la phyir sbyin/ de nas g.yang 'gugs la/ mda' dar g.yob cing*/ bsang dud rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad du/ hṝḥdzaḥ dngos grub mchog stsol rtsa gsum dam can tshogs// bden grub drang srong gtsang rigs dkar phyogs skyong*// khyad par rmugs 'dzin gter bdag sprul 'khor bcas// rab 'byams zhing dang rang rang dgyes pa'i gnas// pho brang lcang lo can nas sku bskyod la// 'da' dka' rdo rje'i tha tshig ma bsnyel bar// bkra shis dpal gyis gang ba'i gnas mchog 'dir// srid zhi'i phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod// sngon byung gdod ma'i mgon pos skad cig la// gzhi snang rig pas 'khor 'das grol gzhir bsdus// lhun rdzogs yon tan phywa dpal g.yang chags ltar// de ring lha khyim 'di ru g.yang 'gugs so// bar du mkhan slob chos gsum zhal 'dzoms te// gangs can ljongs su chos srid dpal 'byor drangs// mtha' bzhi'i phywa tshe g.yang dpal bkug pa bzhin// de ring lha= /phyis dus grub rigs mthu rtsal can rnams kyis// phywa cha bkod cing g.yang cha bkram nas kyang*// srid zhi'i g.yang bsdus sbyin bdag dpal bskyed ltar// de ring lha= hrīḥdzaḥ dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*// chos nyid rnam dag rten 'brel bslu med mthu// lha sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin bden pa yis// srid dang zhi ba'i phywa g.yang 'dir khug cig /mngon dga' dpal ldan bde chen las rab rdzogs// stug po bkod dang chos dbyings lhun grub sbubs// rab 'byam sprul pa'i zhing dang der bzhugs kyi// rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs 'dir khug cig /nam mkha' 'byung bzhi ri rab rgya mtsho dang*// nyi zla gza' skar gling bzhi gling phran khams// nor bu bum bzang dpag bsam ljon shing sogs// brtan pa snod kyi phywa g.yang 'dir=

/drang srong rig 'dzin mkhas grub dge ba'i bshes// lha klu mi dbang sde brgyad mthu bo che// rigs bzhi'i rgyal blon btsun mo khyim bdag sogs// g.yo ba bcud kyi phywa g.yang 'dir= /rgya gar rgya nag o rgyan sham+bha la// gangs can hor bod stag gzig bal po yi// khrom dang ge sar gar log la sogs pa// 'dzam bu'i gling gi phywa g.yang 'dir= /'chi med tshe dang 'grib med bsod nams rgyun// 'dzad med longs spyod snyan grags gzi mdangs stobs// dpal 'byor dbang thang 'khor slob mnga' ris sogs// mtho ris legs dgu'i phywa g.yang 'dir= /rma g.yang zas dang dkor mdzod nor gyi rigs// rkang bzhi phyugs dang bang mdzod 'bru sna tshogs// brgyud 'dzin srid dang rgol 'joms dpung la sogs// btsan phyugs 'phan dar phywa g.yang 'dir khug cig /mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod grub pa'i yon tan dang*// rnal 'byor nyams rtogs gsang 'dzin mthu nus rtsal// chos mthun dkar po'i bsam sbyor ji snyed sogs// dge legs gtan gyi phywa g.yang 'dir khug gcig /hrīḥdzaḥ rnal 'byor rig 'dzin dgongs pa'i rtsal bskyed cing*// leb rgan 'bar ba'i dar gyis g.yab pa'i tshe// rmugs 'dzin chags pa'i mdangs ldan dbyings nas bzhengs// chu dbang ji snyed can gyi thugs dam bskul// da lta snyigs ma'i dus kyi rgud pa shar// bdag dang yon bdag chos ldan 'byor pas dman// de phyir gter gyi bdag po khyod bskul na// thugs dam ma bsnyel phrin las rtsal sprugs la// thugs rje chags pa dbang gi gzi brjid kyis// srid zhi'i dwangs bcud khab len lcags bzhin sdus// sgeg pa'i gzugs dang ne'u le zhal khyim nas// sna tshogs nor bu'i char rgyun 'dzad med phob// 'gugs byed zer gyis lha 'dre mi gsum sdus// 'ching byed rgya yis brtan g.yo'i chos kun chings// dbang mdzad ḍā ki nyi zer rdul ltar 'khrugs// glog 'gyu'i rtsal gyis yid la gang 'dod khug

/lcags kyu 'bar bas srog gi dwangs mar gzer// 'od dmar drwa bas sgo gsum 'chug med sdoms// dregs ldan sems kyi brtan pa dbang med 'phrog /gzugs can gzugs med snang ba chos la sgyur// 'khor 'das lam gyis bsdus pa'i phywa g.yang khug /'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa'i phywa g.yang= /brtan g.yo snod bcud kun gyi phywa= /mi mjed stong gsum zhing gi phywa g.yang khug /khu ye hu lo sngags kyi brda yis 'bod// spro bsdu'i sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin pho nya bkye// bzang shing dad pas gtsang rigs lha srung bskul// lha mda' dar sna'i 'phur mas g.yab 'dor na// ma g.yel ma g.yel rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i lha// ma g.yel ma g.yel rmugs 'dzin nor gyi bdag /sprul pa'i pho nyas 'jig rten gsum bkang la// phywa g.yang thogs med 'gugs pa 'phrin las mdzod// phywa tshe 'od kyi thig le kyi li li// rma g.yang zer gyi dmu thag sha ra ra// dngos grub bdud rtsi'i char chen si li li// dmu g.yang dpal gyi mtsho mo me re re// g.yang gi lha gzhi dkar po bkrag la gsal// tshe bsod dpal gyi lhun po brtan la brjid// phywa g.yang 'byor pa'i snum zhag che la 'thibs// dbang thang nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gsal la brtan// phywa dang bla tshe ri la ma bros la// g.yang dang bsod nams sgo ru mi nyams par// 'gyur med phyag rgya gsum gyi rgyas 'debs shing*// mi gnas mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings su sba// gnod gnas gter gyi bdag po'i mthu rtsal gyis// srid zhi'i phywa g.yang dmigs pa'i 'ben la stims// 'phral yun dge legs nam mkha'i mdzod chen la// dbang bsgyur sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /ces brjod/ grangs gsog byed na/ mchod pa kha gsos nas brlabs te gong ltar mchod cing bstod/ bzlas pa cung zad re dang bcas pa'i mjug tu g.yang 'gugs 'di nyid sbrel nas bskyar bar bya'o// gsum pa ni/ de ltar sgrub zhag lnga bdun sogs gang byed grub pa'i grol rgyu'i nang mor g.yang chog tshar gcig btang nas/

dpon slob thams cad rgyan gos bzang po dang ldan par byas/ yon bdag yod na stan bzang po la bzhag bgegs bskrad bsdus pa sngon du 'gro bas gong gi g.yang 'gugs lan cig brjod nas/ dngos grub bskul ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ gtor ma 'di nyid mgon po dzam+bha la dmar po nor bdag gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du gsal ba de dag gi spyi bor spyan drangs nas dngos grub bskul ba'i rkyen gyis/ lha tshogs rnams kyi sku'i cha dang zhal dang nor bu dang ne'u le dang phywa rdzas rnams las 'dod rgu'i longs spyod kyi char chen po phab nas dngos grub tu stsal bas/ tshe dang bsod nams/ stobs dang gzi brjid la sogs pa rgyas par byas/ gnas khang dang lung pa thams cad zas nor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang bar gyur/ ces mos la yi dam gyi gtor ma/ g.yang bshos/ phywa rdzas/ phywa bum/ mda' dar sogs g.yang rdzas thams cad lag stong ma gyur par rim par gtad la/ hrīḥ shar gyi phyogs nas dngos grub skul ba'i lha// zhi ba'i las mdzad ku ru kul+le dkar// phyag bzhis mda' gzhu lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam rgyud bskul na// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la// nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad zhi bar mdzod// oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya dha na me dhi hrīḥswā hā/ de bzhin du 'gres kha bsgyur bas/ hrīḥ lho yi phyogs= /rgyas pa'i= ser/ phyag bzhis= /rin chen= /bdag cag= /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod// oṃ= hrīḥ nub kyi phyogs= /dbang gi= dmar/ phyag bzhis= /pad+ma= /bdag cag= /khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ= hrīḥ byang gi phyogs= /drag po'i= ljang*/ phyag bzhis= /las kyi= /bdag cag= /dgra bgegs bar gcod thams cad tshar gcod mdzod// oṃ=

hrīḥ dbus kyi phyogs= /mchog gi= mthing*/ phyag bzhis= /sangs rgyas= /bdag cag= /thams cad lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ= mi la tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// nor la g.yang gi dngos grub stsal du gsol// zas la bcud kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya dha na me dhi hrīḥswā hā/ zhes dbyangs dang bcas dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams longs spyad cing phywa bum byo la pra brtags nas 'gyed/ gtor ma sogs rang mal du bzhag la mchod bstod gong ltar dang*/ yig brgya nongs bshags/ 'dir ni rten dang sogs kyis brtan bzhugs byas la g.yang bshos sogs rten rnams bang mdzod du 'jog lha gzhung gi mjug bsdu zhing shis pa brjod pas mtha' rgyas par bya'o// zhes pa'ang blo gter dbang pos legs par bsdebs pa srid zhi'i dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i rgyur sid+dhi rastu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
